name: Kagarino Kirie
source:
Age: Over 300 years old

The heroine of the first kaleidoscope story. A beautiful vampire who upholds an air of superiority. Calm and composed, she does not frequently speak in public. She looks down on humans as an inferior species and is adamant about her opinion. She attends the all-girls school where Shigehiko teaches the first-year student.
